bias.en: Bearish · rebound stalls at the 10-day average
bias.zh: 偏空 · 反弹受阻于 10 日均线

read.en: Intel rose 4.0% on Oct 26 to $90.47, trading between $86.46 and $92.09. It is above the falling 5-day ($89.5) and rising 200-day ($86.1) averages, and below the falling 10-day ($92.6), 30-day ($106.9) and 100-day ($105.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 5 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 5 ($92.72), and RSI is 38.
read.zh: 英特尔 10月26日上涨 4.0%，收于 $90.47，盘中区间 $86.46–92.09。股价位于下行的 5 日（$89.5）和上行的 200 日均线（$86.1）上方，低于下行的 10 日（$92.6）、30 日（$106.9）和 100 日均线（$105.6）。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月5日起看空（$92.72），RSI 为 38。

read.en: The close cleared $87.9 and the $88.8–89.8 resistance (Oct 20 low, 5-day), now support, while the $92.1 high stopped under the 10-day and SAR ($92.6–92.7). Resistance is $92.1–92.7, then $94.4–95.4 (Oct 21 and 19 highs) and $97.7–98.2 (Oct 13–14 lows). Support is $88.8–89.5, then $86.1 (200-day) and $84.6–85.1. A close above $92.7 would target $95.4; a close below $88.8 would reopen $86.
